title: Bridging and messaging
summary: Model deposits, withdrawals, and cross-chain calls as asynchronous flows with explicit fees, status, proofs, and asset identity.

links.description: Understand canonical bridge paths, token movement, retryables, deposits, withdrawals, and asset-identity concerns.
Use the official TypeScript SDK and its docs directory for bridging, deposits, withdrawals, retryables, and message status.
Implement retryable tickets and outbox messages with the required fees, status handling, proofs, and address aliasing.
Optional intent-based route between Arbitrum and 20+ EVM and non-EVM networks, including Solana and Bitcoin, through one SDK or HTTP API. Status is tracked per intent until settlement.
